notes: New: Messages: a real chat app. Your open chats with how many are new, and chats that update the moment the other person sends; Chat with one friend or a group, reply to a message, change or delete your own, and see when it's been seen; A note pops up when a message arrives while you're in another app; mute any chat from its menu; Connect your own bank in Finance > Banking: ask the owner, and once they say yes your payments come in by themselves, matched to your bills; For the owner: bank requests show in Hub > Admin, with Allow, Say no and Take away. Improved: Everything shared (lists, business, messages) now reaches other devices straight away while the server is on, not within a minute; To Do > People: chat with someone in one tap; reminders stay there; Business: a new business sets itself up step by step (how it's set up, categories, invoices or products, first money in, bank and reminders). Skip any step: what's left stays as a checklist; Business: each business has its own bar along the top (Overview, Money, Invoices, Clients, Reports, More) in place of the tiles at the bottom; Business: money out stands next to money in. Tap In or Out to see what's in it, and see where the money goes by category right on the page
